en: TES allowance release may take time due to multiple verification and approval processes.
This includes fund release, eligibility validation, and billing verification.
The process involves coordination between DBM, CHED, and the university.
Any missing documents or strict auditing procedures may further delay the release.
I recommend regularly checking with your scholarship coordinator for updates.
ceb: Ang pag-release sa TES allowance mahimong modugay tungod sa daghang proseso sa verification ug approval.
Lakip niini ang pag-release sa pondo, pag-validate sa eligibility, ug pag-verify sa billing documents.
Ang proseso naglakip sa koordinasyon tali sa DBM, CHED, ug sa unibersidad.
Ang kulang nga dokumento o hugot nga auditing mahimong makapahinay sa pag-release sa allowance.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa inyong scholarship coordinator para sa updates.

en: Students may apply for TES even if they are applicants of other scholarship programs such as REAP or TABUK.
However, TES qualification policies generally do not allow students to receive multiple government-funded educational assistance benefits simultaneously.
Final eligibility is subject to scholarship guidelines and official verification.
I recommend consulting the Scholarship Office for accurate confirmation regarding your eligibility.
ceb: Ang mga estudyante pwede mag-apply sa TES bisan applicant sila sa ubang scholarship programs sama sa REAP o TABUK.
Apan, base sa scholarship policies, dili kasagaran tugotan nga makadawat og daghang government-funded educational assistance sa parehas nga panahon.
Ang final eligibility magdepende sa scholarship guidelines ug official verification.
Mas maayo nga mangutana sa Scholarship Office aron makakuha og eksaktong impormasyon.

en: **University Memorandum No. 01, s. 2026 — Prescribed University Uniform Policy:**

Please be informed that all students are required to wear the complete prescribed university uniform every **Monday**, **Tuesday**, **Thursday**, and **Friday**, effective on their respective dates:

• **2ND YEAR - 4TH YEAR STUDENTS:** Effective **September 7, 2026**
• **1ST YEAR STUDENTS:** Effective **September 14, 2026**
Students are expected to **strictly observe the prescribed university uniform policy** on the indicated days.

Civilian attire (such as decent T-shirts and long pants/jeans) is permitted on **Wednesdays (Wash Days)**, Saturdays, Sundays, and during official university wash-day announcements or enrollment periods.
Note: Sandos/sleeveless shirts, short shorts, ripped/revealing clothing, and rubber slippers are strictly prohibited on campus during class days and office hours.
ceb: **University Memorandum No. 01, s. 2026 — Polisiya sa Opisyal nga Uniporme:**

Palihog pahibalo nga ang tanang estudyante gikinahanglan nga magsul-ob sa kompleto nga prescribed university uniform matag **Lunes**, **Martes**, **Huwebes**, ug **Biyernes**, sugod sa mosunod nga mga petsa:

• **2ND YEAR - 4TH YEAR STUDENTS:** Epektibo **September 7, 2026**
• **1ST YEAR STUDENTS:** Epektibo **September 14, 2026**
Ang mga estudyante gilauman nga **hugot nga mosunod sa prescribed university uniform policy** sa maong mga adlaw.
Ang civilian attire (sama sa desente nga T-shirt ug long pants/maong) gitugotan matag **Miyerkules (Wash Day)**, Sabado, Domingo, ug sa panahon sa opisyal nga enrollment o university events.
Hinumdomi: Ang sando/sleeveless, mugbo kaayo nga shorts, gisi-gisi nga sinina, ug tsinelas hugot nga gidili sulod sa campus panahon sa klase ug office hours.

en: What is BukSU's policy on haircut and colored hair?
According to the BukSU Student Handbook guidelines on grooming and campus decorum:
1. Students are expected to maintain neat, clean, and respectable hairstyles while on campus.
2. For male students in general undergraduate programs, modest and well-groomed haircuts are expected. Extreme or unkempt styles are discouraged.

3. **Board Courses & Clinical Programs**: Programs such as the **College of Nursing (CON)** and **College of Education (COE)** during teaching internships enforce strict professional grooming rules — including natural hair color (no loud/unnatural hair dye) and standard military/prescribed hair cuts for males.
4. Modest hair highlights are generally permitted in non-board programs as long as they adhere to general university decorum.
ceb: Unsa ang patakaran sa BukSU bahin sa haircut ug colored hair?
Sumala sa BukSU Student Handbook guidelines sa grooming ug campus decorum:
1. Ang mga estudyante gilauman nga magmintinar og hapsay, limpyo, ug desente nga estilo sa buhok sulod sa campus.
2. Para sa mga lalaki sa regular nga undergraduate programs, gikinahanglan ang disente ug hapsay nga tupi. Ang sobra o unkempt nga estilo dili girekomenda.

3. **Board Courses & Clinical Programs**: Ang mga kurso sama sa **College of Nursing (CON)** ug **College of Education (COE)** panahon sa internship nagpatuman og estrikto nga grooming rules — lakip ang natural nga kolor sa buhok (bawal ang hayag/unnatural nga hair dye) ug standard prescribed haircut para sa mga lalaki.
4. Ang natural o modest nga hair highlights kasagarang gitugotan sa mga non-board programs basta subay sa kinatibuk-ang university decorum.

en: What are the services offered in the University Guidance Center?
The services that the UGC offers the following services:

Counseling Services: Counseling is considered as the core of guidance services. It aims to assist the students in their emotional, social, physical, spiritual, and cognitive needs. During this time of pandemic the University Guidance Center offers online counselling so that the guidance counselors can reach out to students easier and use the online platform to cater their personal issues, problems and concerns.

Career and Job Placement Services: It is a support service of the University Guidance Center, it aims to address the pre-employment and employment needs of the graduating students and alumnae. The UGC schedules an annual Job Fair. Various agencies and company are invited to take part of the school’s on-campus recruitment program. The UGC offers career seminars and orientation that cater the needs of the students.

Testing Services: The student’s individual strength and weaknesses in the area of personality, IQ and aptitude are assessed through the use of standardized tests. This is handled by the psychometricians. The center provides; Psychological testing for students and testing of faculty and staff applicants.
Exit Interview: The graduating students are given an opportunity to discuss their future plans, career choices and various options for employment.
ceb: Unsa ang mga serbisyo nga gitanyag sa University Guidance Center?
Ang UGC nagatanyag sa mosunod nga mga serbisyo:

Counseling Services: Ang counseling mao ang pinakauyok sa mga serbisyo sa guidance. Tumong niini nga tabangan ang mga estudyante sa ilang emosyonal, sosyal, pisikal, espiritwal, ug panghunahuna nga panginahanglan. en:
**University Memorandum No. 01, s. 2026 — Prescribed University Uniform Policy:**

Please be informed that all students are required to wear the complete prescribed university uniform every **Monday**, **Tuesday**, **Thursday**, and **Friday**, effective on their respective dates:

• **2ND YEAR - 4TH YEAR STUDENTS:** Effective **September 7, 2026**
• **1ST YEAR STUDENTS:** Effective **September 14, 2026**

Students are expected to **strictly observe the prescribed university uniform policy** on the indicated days.

*(Note: **Wednesday** remains the official university **Wash Day** where casual/civilian attire is permitted. Wearing of shorts, sandos/sleeveless shirts, ripped clothes, and rubber slippers is strictly prohibited on campus during class days and office hours).*
You can also read other BukSU Policies through this link: https://buksu.edu.ph/security-services-unit/

Palihog pahibalo nga ang tanang estudyante gikinahanglan nga magsul-ob sa kompleto nga prescribed university uniform matag **Lunes**, **Martes**, **Huwebes**, ug **Biyernes**, sugod sa mosunod nga mga petsa:

• **2ND YEAR - 4TH YEAR STUDENTS:** Epektibo **September 7, 2026**
• **1ST YEAR STUDENTS:** Epektibo **September 14, 2026**

Ang mga estudyante gilauman nga **hugot nga mosunod sa prescribed university uniform policy** sa maong mga adlaw.

*(Pahinumdom: Ang **Miyerkules** nagpabilin nga opisyal nga **Wash Day** diin gitugotan ang casual/civilian attire. Ang pagsul-ob og shorts, sando/sleeveless, gisi-gisi nga sinina, ug tsinelas hugot nga gidili sulod sa campus panahon sa klase ug office hours).*

en:
Here are some of the Bukidnon State University policies, you can also visit this BukSU official Website for more information about the policies of Bukidnon State University:
 https://buksu.edu.ph/security-services-unit/

**Dress Code and Personal Access**
• Prohibited Attire: The security manual explicitly states: Proper and decent attire upon entering the BUKSU premises, offices shall be observed. Thus, **wearing of shorts and sando shall not be allowed to enter the school premises during class days and office hours** except during legitimate school activities with permission from the authorities.
• "No ID, No Entry" Policy: All students across all levels and employees must wear or present their official school ID upon entering the campus.

**Campus Curfew Policy**
• College Students: Not allowed to stay inside the campus **beyond 9:30 PM** (unless attending official school evening activities).
• General Campus Lockout: No **persons are allowed inside the campus beyond 10:00 PM** (including dorm residents, with exceptions for school officials and graduate students/DepEd Fellows logged by security).

**Vehicle and Traffic Regulations**
• Motorcycle Mufflers: Motorcycles with **modified mufflers that produce annoying or loud sounds are strictly banned** from entering the campus, even with a valid gate pass.
• Minors / Students: A **No Driver's License, No Entry** policy is strictly enforced for elementary and high school student drivers from Monday to Sunday.
• Vehicle Passes: Regular vehicles entering the campus must display a **valid Vehicle Gate Pass Sticker issued by the Office of the Chief Administrative Officer.** Visitors must leave a valid ID at the gate in exchange for a visitor’s pass.
ceb: Ania ang pipila sa mga nag-unang polisiya sa Bukidnon State University, mahimo usab nimong bisitahon ang opisyal nga website sa BukSU alang sa dugang impormasyon: https://buksu.edu.ph/security-services-unit/

**Dress Code ug Personal Access**
• Gidili nga Pamesti: Ang security manual klarong nag-ingon: Kinahanglan ang husto ug desente nga pamesti pagsulod sa BUKSU premises ug mga opisina. Busa, ang **pagsul-ob og shorts ug sando dili tugotan nga makasulod sa eskwelahan sa mga adlaw sa klase ug office hours** gawas lang kon adunay lehitimong kalihokan nga gitugotan sa awtoridad.
• "No ID, No Entry" Policy: Ang tanang estudyante sa tanang ang-ang ug mga empleyado kinahanglang magsul-ob o magpakita sa ilang opisyal nga school ID sa pagsulod sa campus.

**Curfew sa Campus**
• College Students: Dili tugotan nga magpabilin sulod sa campus **lapas sa 9:30 PM** (gawas kon motambong og opisyal nga kalihokan sa eskwelahan sa gabii).
• General Campus Lockout: **Walay gitugotan sulod sa campus lapas sa 10:00 PM** (lakip ang mga nag-dorm, gawas sa mga school officials ug graduate students/DepEd Fellows nga na-log sa security).

**Regulasyon sa Sakyanan ug Trapiko**
• Tambutso sa Motor: Ang mga motorsiklo nga adunay **bora-bora o modified mufflers nga saba ug makadisturbo hugot nga gidili** sa pagsulod sa campus, bisan pa kon adunay valid gate pass.
• Minors / Estudyante: Ang **No Driver's License, No Entry** nga polisiya hugot nga gipatuman alang sa mga estudyante gikan Lunes hangtod Domingo.
• Vehicle Passes: Ang mga regular nga sakyanan kinahanglang magpakita og **valid Vehicle Gate Pass Sticker gikan sa Office of the Chief Administrative Officer.** Ang mga bisita kinahanglang magbilin og valid ID sa gate baylo sa visitor's pass.

en: What are the office hours of Bukidnon State University?
Bukidnon State University offices, including the Registrar’s Office and the Accounting Office, operate only from Monday to Friday.
Office hours are 8:00 AM to 12:00 NN and 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
They are closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
Make sure to plan your visits during the official office hours.
For urgent matters, you can check if services are available online or contact the offices directly.
